Question: Please, tell about illegal hawkers and illegal slums encroachment on roads in Mumbai in the light of Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 5462 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 957/717=H) It is not allowed. If they use the place temporarily and it does not create problem for the passers-by then it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
